chung.Learning-Teaching Method: Lectures, Tutorials, Discussions, Laboratory work, Group, Seminars
chung.Description: This course provides an introduction to visual communication design for students and provides them with the knowledge and skills to communicate their ideas and processes in a visual form more effectively. As a means of questioning and applying fundamental theories, concepts, and techniques, students produce visually meaningful projects. The course examines the basic elements of visual communication and how context shapes visual forms production and reception. Students will also learn to analyze the attention-getting qualities of form that engage people in compelling interactions. Teaching methods used include: Lectures, Tutorials, Discussions, Laboratory work, Group work, and Seminars.
chung.StudentTasks:
1. Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
2. Actively participate in class activities
3. Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class
4. Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose
5. Read the textbook in advance
6. Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/gui/Home) for up-to-date information and material of the course.
7. Complete course's Portfolio with full contents of exercises and submit to the teacher after the course.
chung.Tools:
Individual tools prepared by students:
- 1 folder (size A2)
- Paper (size A2, A3, A4), A1 backboard paper
- Collecting newspaper, magazine having color photos
- Color, pencil, eraser, brushes, black ink pen
- Ruler, paper knife, scissors, paper sticking-plaster, double sided tape, glue
- Laptop
- Digital graphic design tools
- Suitable Generative AI tools
- Video recording equipment

taiLieu: Visual Communication from Theory to Practice
clo: Explain the way people communicate visually, and how communication design organizes experience in a variety of structures.
Apply knowledge to arrange the elements — words, images and/or symbols that contribute to the construction of meaning, utilizing tools such as traditional tools, digital tools, or generative AI.

Analyze the attention-getting qualities of form, which constitute an essential first step to appropriate interpretive behaviors, engage people in compelling interactions, and extend meaning beyond the momentary encounter with the message.
Create a composition that communicates and provides information about relevant interactions among the components of a message by applying knowledge of interaction, interpretation, and experience.
Create visual communication design solutions for specific cultural and digital contexts by applying manual and/or digital methods of retaining and extending meaning.
Have a positive attitude and a professional working style.
danhGia: Student creates a drawing as a means by which ideas and concepts are communicated. Student explains how the assignment communicates visually and improves the viewers' experience with variety of structure.

Student creates a composition as a means by which ideas and concepts are communicated. Student analyzes the attention-getting qualities. Students are required to use variety of tools: hand drawing, digital drawing, generative AI.
Students apply knowledge of visual elements, generate and develop personal visual ideas/concepts through a collage composition.
Student research and deconstruct a story by setting, characters, objects, events with chosen medium providing multiple frame work.
Student research a specific theme, idea, and construct a complete story and create method to present the story.
buoi: INTRODUCTION TO VISUAL COMMUNICATION — Sensing; Selecting; Perceiving. Sensing + selecting + perceiving = seeing
INTRODUCTION TO VISUAL COMMUNICATION — 1. Making sense of experience; 2. Experience and Time; 3. Experience and Media; 4. Introduction to generative AI in Visual Communication
DEFINITION OF BASIC ARTS AND GRAPHIC ELEMENTS — 1. Point; 2. Line; 3. Shape; 4. Background
DEFINITION OF BASIC ARTS AND GRAPHIC ELEMENTS — 1. Point; 2. Line; 3. Shape; 4. Background

ASSIGNMENT 1. DRAWING AS A MEAN OF COMMUNICATION (10%) — Drawing a black and white piece of visual idea/concept to create a mood/send a message; Use any FORM (dots, lines, shapes…) that helps communicating the message; Use observational, visualization and presentation drawing; May use tools to generate references for inspiration
ASSIGNMENT 1. DRAWING AS A MEAN OF COMMUNICATION (10%) — (như buổi 7)
ASSIGNMENT 1. DRAWING AS A MEAN OF COMMUNICATION (10%) — (như buổi 7)
ASSIGNMENT 1. DRAWING AS A MEAN OF COMMUNICATION (Continue)
ASSIGNMENT 1. DRAWING AS A MEAN OF COMMUNICATION (Continue)
ASSIGNMENT 1. DRAWING AS A MEAN OF COMMUNICATION (Continue) — Grading and Evaluating Assignment 01
GETTING ATTENTION — 1. Contrast; 2. Figure-ground and color
GETTING ATTENTION — 3. Size constancy, scale, and proportion; 4. Layering; 5. Symmetry/Asymmetry
GETTING ATTENTION — 7. Pattern; 8. Series and Sequences; 9. Rhythm and pacing; 10. Motion

ASSIGNMENT 2. COMPOSITION (15%) — Use the vocabulary of visual message and apply principles to make a set of composition that conveys a message about a chosen topic; Free method of expressing; May use tools to generate references for inspiration
ASSIGNMENT 2. COMPOSITION (Continue) — Developing and executing ideas
ASSIGNMENT 2. COMPOSITION (Continue) — Developing and executing ideas using AI and digital tools

ORIENTING FOR USE AND INTERPRETATION — 1. Affordances; 2. Feedback; 5. Hierarchy; 6. Reading Pattern
ORIENTING FOR USE AND INTERPRETATION — 5. Mapping; 6. Wayfinding; 7. Edge relationships; 8. Direction; 9. Point of view

ASSIGNMENT 3. COLLAGE (15%) — Research theme; Research materials (photos, magazines, printed materials…), test different textures, apply color theory to create moods and special effects; May use tools to generate references for inspiration
ASSIGNMENT 3. COLLAGE (Continue) — Grading and Evaluating Assignment 03
INTERACTING, INTERPRETING AND EXPERIENCING — 1. The nature of signs; 2. Icon, index and symbol; 3. Denotation and Connotation
INTERACTING, INTERPRETING AND EXPERIENCING — 5. Abstraction; 6. Materiality; 7. Substitution; 8. Metaphor; 9. Appropriation; 10. Ambiguity

ASSIGNMENT 4. MULTIPLE FRAME STORY (20%) — Research a specific theme, idea; Deconstruct a story by setting, characters, objects, events; Free media chosen; Practice in group; May use tools to generate references for inspiration and materials
ASSIGNMENT 4. MULTIPLE FRAME STORY (Continue) — Grading and Evaluating Assignment 04
RETAINING AND EXTENDING MEANING — 1. Memory; 3. Stereotypes; 4. Archetypes
RETAINING AND EXTENDING MEANING — 5. Narrative; 6. Mnemonics; 7. Chunking; 8. Redundancy

ASSIGNMENT 5. VISUAL STORYTELLING (30%) — Research a specific theme, idea; Construct a complete story and create method to present the story; Students can choose between photographic collage, illustrative presentation, video, interactive product, or model making; Work in groups; Free media chosen to present; May use tools to generate references for inspiration and materials
ASSIGNMENT 5. VISUAL STORYTELLING (Continue) — Grading and Evaluating Assignment 05
ghiChuKiemChung: ⚠️ Môn này KHÔNG có thi cuối kỳ — toàn bộ điểm là 5 bài tập lớn + điểm chuyên cần. Nói rõ cho sinh viên: Assignment 5 một mình đã chiếm 30%.

⚠️ Mục StudentTasks vẫn ghi 'Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination' dù môn KHÔNG có final exam — mâu thuẫn trong chính syllabus. Giữ nguyên, nêu cho sinh viên.
⚠️ Cả 4 giáo trình đều là SÁCH GIẤY, trường KHÔNG công bố link nào. Dùng thẻ `.the-sach khong-link`, tuyệt đối đừng bịa link.
⚠️ Sách CHÍNH là 'Visual Communication Design' (Meredith Davis & Jamer Hunt, Bloomsbury, 2017, 2nd ed, ISBN 9781350031838) — cột Is Main Material = True.

⚠️ ISBN của tài liệu #4 'Visual Communication from Theory to Practice' ghi 9782940373093 — tiền tố 978-2 là nhà xuất bản Pháp/Thuỵ Sĩ (AVA Publishing), trong khi cột NXB ghi Bloomsbury. Giữ nguyên như trường ghi, nêu là chỗ cần kiểm lại.

⚠️ Đánh số mục trong kế hoạch buổi BỊ NHẢY: buổi 22 liệt kê '1. Affordances, 2. Feedback, 5. Hierarchy, 6. Reading Pattern' (thiếu 3, 4); buổi 23 lại bắt đầu từ '5. Mapping' (trùng số 5); buổi 31 có '1, 2, 3' rồi buổi 32 bắt đầu từ '5' (thiếu 4); buổi 46 có '1, 3, 4' (thiếu 2); buổi 15 bắt đầu từ '7' (thiếu 6). Giữ nguyên bảng gốc.
⚠️ Rất nhiều buổi lặp lại y nguyên nội dung (7-9, 16-18, 24-26, 33-35, 48-59) — đó là các buổi làm bài tập tại lớp. Giữ nguyên.
Dụng cụ học: môn này cần VẬT TƯ THẬT (giấy A1/A2/A3, dao rọc giấy, keo, bút mực đen, báo/tạp chí cũ để cắt dán) chứ không chỉ laptop — sinh viên hay bỏ sót, phải nhấn mạnh.
